code_prompt_defaults.json_output_contract: Return a JSON object with "answer" and "annotation".

code_prompt_defaults.question_text_feature_side_object_count: How many foreground objects are {relation_word} the {feature_name}? If none are there, answer 0.
code_prompt_defaults.question_text_on_feature_object_count: How many foreground objects are {feature_phrase}? If none are there, answer 0.
code_prompt_defaults.question_text_crossing_feature_count: How many {crossing_name} cross the {crossed_feature_name}? If none are there, answer 0.
code_prompt_defaults.question_text_building_window_count: How many {window_phrase} are shown on the buildings? If none are there, answer 0.
code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint_feature_side: set "answer" to the count of foreground objects {relation_word} the {feature_name} as an integer, using 0 if none match
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_feature_side: set "annotation" to a JSON array of [x0, y0, x1, y1] boxes in image pixel coordinates around every counted foreground object {relation_word} the {feature_name}; use [] if none match
code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint_on_feature: set "answer" to the count of foreground objects {feature_phrase} as an integer, using 0 if none match
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_on_feature: set "annotation" to a JSON array of [x0, y0, x1, y1] boxes in image pixel coordinates around every counted foreground object {feature_phrase}; use [] if none match
code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint_crossing_feature: set "answer" to the count of {crossing_name} crossing the {crossed_feature_name} as an integer, using 0 if none match
code_prompt_defaults.annotation_hint_crossing_feature: set "annotation" to a JSON array of [x0, y0, x1, y1] boxes in image pixel coordinates around every counted {crossing_name}; use [] if none match
code_prompt_defaults.answer_hint_building_window: set "answer" to the count of {window_phrase} on the buildings as an integer, using 0 if none match
